correctness.rationale: The cut-vertex lemma is proved directly by components after vertex deletion. Every noncut cycle vertex has exactly two neighbors in its sole cycle. Two separated omission runs disconnect the selected induced subgraph because the block-cut graph is a tree, and a run of length at least three leaves an undominated free vertex. The converse construction yields connected dominated sets independent across cycle blocks, proving the exact product. For q=2, t<=1; for q=3 in any articulated cycle, t<=2; for q>=4, t<=q. This gives nonnegative quadratic discriminants except for isolated C3. 6,280,063 independently enumerated vertex subsets and 7,105 additional discriminant checks support but do not replace the argument. The n=1,2 cases are separate.

value.rationale: The exact all-cardinality polynomial is obtained for every finite connected cactus, a natural infinite graph class admitting arbitrarily many independently positioned tree and cycle blocks. The result isolates local combinatorial q,t statistics, provides an explicit efficient formula for all coefficients, and establishes a sharp universal real-rootedness exception (triangle) with log-concavity and unimodality consequences. Unlike only the cycle or friendship specialization, arbitrary cactus block composition is a substantive structural extension.
